headline: Fun little @typesafeai jev demo to analyze book plots of the top 250 sci-fi and fantasy books to help you find your next read.
text:
Fun little @typesafeai jev demo to analyze book plots of the top 250 sci-fi and fantasy books to help you find your next read.

Ask stuff about the story, like  "protoganist named david", "class warfare", etc.

It reads each Wikipedia plot — not the book — and keeps the matches.…
